Since the new update, original mod @Peglius was able to add some new faces to the team and get things going around here.

Instead of just defining the rules, I wanted to host an open discussion here with the rest of the mods as well as the community on what rules we would like to see. As this is a humor sub, the rules and this discussion can be simple and lighthearted, but nonetheless important. We should decide on what kind of content we will disallow (if any), submission policies, general posting guidelines, etc.

I would also like to get some feedback for the subverse CSS. I am not an expert in anyway, but I've built up some experience from previous places. If anyone would like to volunteer to help with the sub/banner etc that would be great.

Specifically would like to hear from the team @9-11 @aaragon @CatManDew. Please use this thread for any further discussions, feedback, criticism etc.

I am a firm believer that we should keep the "if it makes you laugh post it" mentality. In my opinion the only rules here should be site rules, with the addition that the post must ATTEMPT humor, just because everyone doesn't find a post funny, doesn't mean its out of place here! that being said, spam, and clearly off topic/ non-humorous posts will be removed! As for the CSS we should have something unique! (whatever that ends up looking like)

I agree. I also think a link should be part of some image/video hosting platform, as a lot of web links aren't accessible by everyone.

On top of that, some sites that I've seen linked too are nothing more than buzzfeed clones, so having our subverse link to their site makes no sense. Either using slimgur, Veuwer, Youtube, streamable, and other good sites should have a soft requirement and be in the sidebar.
i agree with the "soft requirement" sentiment, more a guide line for the sidebar!

To avoid the buzzfeed type posts we can implement a no clickbait rule. Another thing that I believe should be a rule is for users to add a [NSFW] infront of their title, at least until user flairs are implemented.

As for the design, I think we could have a sticky and cycle out the CSS design through the week - asking for user feedback.

Input?

Edit: and also maybe something about reposts, I personally find those irritating.

A NSFW would be great, but the "no clickbaity title" is really vague and we should probably hold off without getting too controlling.

We can at least add a flair tag for reposts. I think that would do it's job if identifying it as such, and also letting it be there for other users who haven't seen it yet.

I enjoy the clean design of this CSS, but I'm willing to look at others. I also agree with the reposts comments and click bait sites. My only comment is I'd rather not see cruel joke posts, but not sure if that's a totally subjective assessment on the part of the reader and thus not really enforceable, or what our community would decide. I want to laugh here, and hope to enjoy our subverse for a long time.
